create_env_matrix_game: create an iterated matrix game environment for prisoners dilemma or matching pennies
setup_agents_opponent_shaping: setup opponent shaping agents for each player in an iterated matrix game environment
collect_batch_episodes: collect a batch of episodes from agents interacting with the environment
log_epoch_training_data: log epoch training data including action probabilities and rewards to wandb
run_lola_training_experiment: run a LOLA or LOLA-DiCE training experiment on iterated matrix games via CLI
